Overview

Build With Bharat 5.0 – National-Level Hackathon

Organised by CodeVerse | Venue: Microsoft Office, Gurugram

About the Event

Build With Bharat 5.0 is a national-level hackathon organised by CodeVerse, bringing together passionate developers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across India. The event aims to encourage innovation, collaboration, and practical problem-solving through technology.

Participants will develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges across domains such as Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Blockchain, Cloud Computing, and Open Innovation.

Eligibility & Team Formation

  • Students from recognised colleges and universities across India are eligible to participate.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialisation teams are allowed.
  • Team size and registration requirements will be specified in the official event guidelines.
  • All team members must complete the required registration formalities.

Competition Format

  • Registration: Register through Unstop before the deadline.
  • Shortlisting: Eligible teams may be shortlisted based on their submissions and the announced criteria.
  • Offline Hackathon: Selected teams will build and demonstrate their solutions at Microsoft Office, Gurugram.
  • Final Evaluation: Projects will be judged on innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, problem relevance, and presentation.

The final schedule, problem statements, submission deadlines, and round timings will be communicated by the organising team.

Rules & Regulations

  • Each participant can register with only one team.
  • Teams must adhere to the announced deadlines and submission guidelines.
  • Projects must be original, and any third-party resources or AI tools used must be appropriately disclosed.
  • Plagiarism, fraudulent submissions, and unethical activities may lead to disqualification.
  • Participants must follow the venue policies and maintain professional conduct.
  • The jury's decision regarding project evaluation will be final.

Why Participate?

Build With Bharat 5.0 offers an opportunity to showcase your skills, collaborate with talented innovators, develop practical solutions, and gain recognition for your work.
